headline_marked: Ten-man England [[reach World Cup quarterfinals]] after 3-2 win over Mexico
headline: Ten-man England reach World Cup quarterfinals after 3-2 win over Mexico
summary: The Three Lions overcame a red card and a hostile crowd of 80,000 at the Estadio Azteca to secure their spot in the final eight.
details: England secured a dramatic 3-2 victory over Mexico at the Estadio Azteca on Monday, advancing to the World Cup quarterfinals. The match was a high-tension thriller that tested the team's resilience in front of a partisan crowd.

Jude Bellingham starred for England, firing in a brilliant brace in the first half. Captain Harry Kane also contributed with a penalty to maintain a two-goal cushion after the team faced a significant setback.
The game took a dramatic turn when Jarell Quansah was sent off, leaving England to defend their lead with only 10 men for more than half an hour.
Mexico fought back, with Raul Jimenez scoring a penalty to spark a frantic finale. England clung on through 11 minutes of added time to secure the win.
England head coach Thomas Tuchel praised the team's mentality, stating that the team never gives up and never loses belief even when the going gets tough.
England's next opponent in the quarterfinals will be Norway, as they celebrate a victory in one of the tournament's wildest contests.
caption:
10 men, 80,000 hostile fans, and a red card. England survives a thriller at the Azteca to reach the quarterfinals!

England secured a dramatic 3-2 victory over Mexico at the Estadio Azteca on Monday, advancing to the World Cup quarterfinals. The match was a high-tension thriller that tested the team's resilience in front of a partisan crowd.

Jude Bellingham starred for England, firing in a brilliant brace in the first half. Captain Harry Kane also contributed with a penalty to maintain a two-goal cushion after the team faced a significant setback.

The game took a dramatic turn when Jarell Quansah was sent off, leaving England to defend their lead with only 10 men for more than half an hour.

Mexico fought back, with Raul Jimenez scoring a penalty to spark a frantic finale. England clung on through 11 minutes of added time to secure the win.

England head coach Thomas Tuchel praised the team's mentality, stating that the team never gives up and never loses belief even when the going gets tough.

England's next opponent in the quarterfinals will be Norway, as they celebrate a victory in one of the tournament's wildest contests.

headline_marked: 20,000 workers [[laid off in six months]] across Bangladesh
headline: 20,000 workers laid off in six months across Bangladesh
summary: Data from industrial police and garment associations show a sharp rise in job losses, primarily in the RMG sector, amid financial crises and falling orders.
details: At least 20,000 workers have lost their jobs in the first six months of this year, according to data from industrial police, BGMEA, and BKMEA. The majority of these layoffs have occurred within the ready-made garment (RMG) sector.
BGMEA reports that 19,188 workers were laid off from 80 member factories, 27 of which have shut down completely. In Gazipur alone, 44 factories laid off 2,155 workers between January and June.

Factory owners attribute the layoffs to a decrease in export orders and financial crises exacerbated by a lack of cooperation from banks. Some owners also cite misconduct or fraudulent documentation as reasons for dismissal.

Labor leaders and former Industrial Bangladesh Council Secretary Salauddin Swapon suggest a different cause. They claim some owners are targeting workers who attempt to form trade unions following recent legal amendments making unionization easier.
The Export Promotion Bureau (EPB) notes a slight decline in RMG exports, with exports for the first 11 months of the last fiscal year dropping by 3.41% compared to the previous year.
Specific instances include the Al-Muslim Group in Savar, which laid off 1,868 workers from three factories immediately after the Eid-ul-Adha holidays, citing business downturns.
